articles.title: Asian Stocks Set to Fall as Oil Surges Past $100: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: A global selloff in technology stocks gained momentum as doubts over returns from billions of dollars spent on artificial intelligence were compounded by a surge in oil prices that rekindled inflation concerns.
